verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a Trustpilot summary saying users appreciate Relay's helpful customer support, which shows a support team exists. Nothing shows it is live, available around the clock, or has an escalation path for urgent account issues. The support-site docs cover only self-service how-tos. Missing for 10: documented live channels (phone or chat), 24/7 or after-hours availability, an urgent-issue or escalation path, stated response times, and hands-on corroboration of reaching a person quickly.
